prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production artwork for the Mars combination game, in the established realistic painterly retro-industrial style: cream factory equipment, muted teal habitat fittings, cobalt scientific fittings, mustard mobility accents, ochre Martian terrain, modest wear. Local construction is simple cut and bolted straight steel, cloth and foil; imported pressure vessels and instruments retain their precision. No people, lettering, captions, labels, numbers, border graphics or UI. Generate COMPLETE SCENES, not isolated items. Every state has the exact SAME CAMERA, perspective, geography, light, object size and position. Change ONLY the named construction state. Leave generous quiet foreground for movable supplies. The lower half is simple natural ground or floor, not extra equipment. These paintings will be registered and cropped into background and changing fixed objects. Recurring items must retain their exact design. Reference images establish design and style, not an invitation to add all their objects.
Create a single WIDE LANDSCAPE scene-state sheet: 6 equal SQUARE full-scene panels in 2 row(s) and 3 columns. Each panel is SQUARE, not a narrow portrait strip. The complete sheet has aspect ratio 3:2. Arrange states in reading order. The full room or outdoor worksite is shown in each square scene; extra gameplay foreground is framed separately during export.
SCENE: An interior working view of the same pressurized cave farm, cream fabric enclosure, teal service seams, stable rock glimpsed beyond its entrance, strip grow lights already fitted. The three-zone structure occupies the upper middle and leaves the entire lower aisle empty. Preserve the exact THREE ZONE plan and one reservoir in every later state: deep left potato bay, narrow rear soybean row, shallow right lettuce shelf. One person builds all supports from manageable bolted steel lengths.
STATE 1: Empty prepared growing-room floor under the installed strip lights. No bed frames or reservoir yet.
STATE 2: Three adjoining simple steel bed frames are installed: a deep potato bay at LEFT, a narrow soybean row across the BACK, and a shallow lettuce shelf at RIGHT. Plain straight bolted stock, no linings yet.
STATE 3: Those same frames now have food-safe cream liners. Their drain outlets are bare; the shared reservoir has not been fitted.
STATE 4: Same lined frames with drain hoses attached and their loose return ends waiting below. NO reservoir or pump yet.
STATE 5: Same lined frames with the one shared cream reservoir and small irrigation pump fitted beneath the beds. The drains are still unconnected, with bare outlets. No extra reservoir.
STATE 6: Same lined frames, now with both the shared reservoir/pump AND the attached drain hoses. One common return ends ABOVE the reservoir waterline, leaving an obvious aerating air gap. Empty growing zones, no medium, plants or nutrients drawn as coloured slime.
